BiblicalUsage: Once, in the table of nations: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel, and Erech, and Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar. The place is covered in the Biblical Places collection — this study covers only how the name is used.
TheologicalSignificance: A city name carries no sermon, and I will not invent one. What it marks is the start of something: the first kingdom after the flood, built by a mighty hunter, in the land where rebellion would take its tallest form.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
